text.p: These were the main news headlines reported by Lithuania's radio M1 Plus at noon on Tuesday. Reuters has not verified these reports and cannot vouch for their accuracy.
- Lithuanian companies might be released from fines and overdue payments to the budget if they can prove that the sums have accumulated because of circumstances the companies could not predict.

- Lithuania's Social Democrats attacked the government's privatisation programme at a news conference on Tuesday, saying that it wanted to sell strategic enterprises because it could not collect revenue in any other manner.
- The interior ministers of the three Baltic countries signed a co-operation agreement in Tallinn to fight the trade in illicit drugs.
- The Bank of Lithuania issued the first copy of its new publication, "Money Studies", which will focus on the country's banking market. The presentation of the issue is scheduled for Wednesday.
